title: Probing DNA - transcription factor interactions using single-molecule fluorescence detection in nanofluidic devices
authors: Mattia Fontana; Šarūnė Ivanovaitė; Simon Lindhoud; Willy van den Berg; Dolf Weijers; Johannes Hohlbein
one_liner_zh: 该文利用单分子FRET和纳米流体装置研究植物ARF转录因子与DNA响应元件的结合，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作实验检测，但缺乏AI或物理模拟建模方法，仅部分契合本课题。
abstract: Single-molecule fluorescence detection offers powerful ways to study biomolecules and their complex interactions. Here, we combine nanofluidic devices and camera-based, single-molecule Förster resonance energy transfer (smFRET) detection to study the interactions between plant transcription factors of the auxin response family (ARF) and DNA oligonucleotides that contain target DNA response elements. In particular, we show that the binding of the unlabelled ARF DNA binding domain (ARF-DBD) to donor and acceptor labelled DNA oligonucleotides can be detected by changes in the FRET efficiency and changes in the diffusion coefficient of the DNA. In addition, our data on fluorescently labelled ARF-DBDs suggest that, at nanomolar concentrations, ARF-DBDs are exclusively present as monomers. In general, the fluidic framework of freely diffusing molecules minimizes potential surface-induced artifacts, enables high-throughput measurements and proved to be instrumental in shedding more light on the interactions between ARF-DBDs monomers and between ARF-DBDs and their DNA response element.
abstract_zh: 单分子荧光检测为研究生物分子及其复杂相互作用提供了强有力的手段。在此，我们结合纳米流体装置和基于相机的单分子福斯特共振能量转移 (smFRET) 检测，研究生长素响应家族 (ARF) 植物转录因子与含有靶DNA响应元件的DNA寡核苷酸之间的相互作用。特别地，我们展示了未标记的ARF DNA结合域 (ARF-DBD) 与供体和受体标记的DNA寡核苷酸的结合，可通过FRET效率的变化以及DNA扩散系数的变化来检测。此外，我们关于荧光标记ARF-DBD的数据表明，在纳摩尔浓度下，ARF-DBD仅以单体形式存在。总体而言，自由扩散分子的流体框架最大限度地减少了潜在的表面诱导伪影，实现了高通量测量，并证明在揭示ARF-DBD单体之间以及ARF-DBD与其DNA响应元件之间的相互作用方面具有重要作用。
